A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 21-page versions of the same RAPNet study, including Appendices A-E. Their text, equations, figures and tables can be reliably matched.

before.justification: v1 reports original solver benchmarks, setup timings and ablations in Section 5, plus elasticity, Stokes and computational experiments in Appendices D-E.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including iteration counts, setup timings, component ablations and convergence rates.

M1.justification: Section 4 retains the same sparse additive corrections, shared GNN architecture, adjacent-level processing, training loss and setup-only inference procedure.

E1.justification: The seven main graph/PDE datasets and Appendix D's elasticity and Stokes tests are retained. Training-to-evaluation domain transfers and evaluated mesh scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: AGG and sparsified smoothed aggregation (SpSA) remain the evaluated baselines in the corresponding main and appendix experiments. No comparator is added, removed or replaced.

E3.justification: Standalone and GMRES(2) evaluation, the 10^-6 residual threshold, 1,000-iteration cap, sample sizes and hierarchy settings are unchanged. Completing the missing angle entry in Appendix C.5.2 clarifies documentation without establishing a revised experimental protocol.

E4.justification: Table 3 retains the same ablations of operator corrections and interlevel mixing. Appendix D's transfer tests and Appendix E's computational and convergence analyses are also unchanged.

E5.justification: The reported 100-example/run averages, standard deviations and explanation of large deviations caused by iteration limits are unchanged. No seed information or statistical procedure is added.

E6.justification: Reported values and findings are unchanged, including Tables 1-3 and 8-12 and Figure 6. Two SpSA entries receive bold formatting in Table 1, but their means and uncertainties remain identical.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulations, Algorithm 1 and Appendix D's block-preconditioning derivation are unchanged. Appendix A replaces 'error iteration matrix' with 'error iteration' while retaining Equation (15), a wording correction.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution bullets and conclusion retain the same claims about sparse AMG corrections, setup-only neural inference and generalization to larger systems and deeper hierarchies.

C2.justification: Interpretations of convergence, sparsity and generalization are retained. Section 4.2 still identifies classical smoothing, fixed aggregation and the absence of theoretical convergence guarantees as limitations.

D1.justification: Appendix C.5.2 supplies the missing 0 in the cuboid-cutout rotation set, making it explicitly {0°, 15°, 30°, 45°}. This small reproducibility correction resolves an incomplete parameter entry; other implementation and resource details remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works, reference list and positioning relative to previous neural solvers and AMG approaches are unchanged. Related-work edits concern punctuation and wording.

P1.justification: v2 makes scattered grammar, punctuation and terminology corrections, including 'featuers' to 'features' in Appendix B.2. It also adds the Data Science Research Center to an affiliation. Section order and narrative structure are retained.

P2.justification: Table 1 newly boldfaces SpSA's GMRES results of 60 ± 4 and 66 ± 4 for the 227K and 355K anisotropic-diffusion systems. Minor text and table reflow occurs; figures, captions and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 provides a small gain in clarity and reproducibility by completing the rotation-angle specification in Appendix C.5.2 and correcting wording and typographical errors throughout. The method, experimental evidence and stated limitations remain unchanged, limiting the overall improvement.
